messages:
Samir: Quick sync 1  Cognify (ISV) wants an official adapter bundle (LangChain + LlamaIndex) to ship with AtlasGate's NVIDIA marketplace SKU. Need owners and a minimal checklist.
Olga: I can own the adapter spec + PR. target v0: ingest, vector query, embeddings, streaming output. estimate 8 working days.
Ben: Eng ok for v0 in 8 days. need a sample corpus and an orchestrator example (retrieve -> rerank -> summarize).
Clara: DevRel will produce a 1-page quickstart + 90s demo GIF. need streaming + embeddings for the notebook to look slick.
Samir: Marketplace/legal note 1: AtlasGate requires publisher agreement, security attestation, and a deploy manifest for the bundle. Also want a small perf table.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace manifest must include: 512x512 icon, one-line tagline, 1-paragraph description (<=2000 chars), support contact, pricing SKU mapping. Manifest due 10 business days pre-publish.
Olga: sample demo curl for README:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/cognify/run \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
 -d '{"flow":"kb-retrieval-rerank-summary","source":"lindex://cognify-kb","max_tokens":120,"stream":true}'
```
Ben: I'll queue perf runs on AtlasGate A10-equivalent nodes. request: 3 workloads (short/med/long). ETA 4 business days.
Clara: Proposed timeline: PR in 8 working days, QA + smoke 3 days, perf 4 days, assets + manifest 4 days, legal 5 days. external listing target = 4 weeks. internal demo = 3 weeks.
Samir: Owners: Adapter = @Olga, Perf/infra = @Ben, Docs/demo = @Clara, Marketplace/legal & publish = @Samir, Assets/Design = @Design.
Design: Will queue GIF + screenshots when notebook link is live. need high-res logos and color hex.
Olga: pushing an adapter config to repo today (`name: rwd-cognify-lc`, `batch:8`, `stream:true`, `quant:q4_0`).
Ben: perf job submitted (JOB-APX-112). will paste results here when done.
Samir: Great. I'll open the marketplace intake ticket and attach the publisher checklist. Also scheduling 15-min sync every Tue until publish. react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Olga: :white_check_mark: PR draft ready for review.
Clara: :eyes: notebook scaffolded, will add cells for both hosted and private flows.
Ben: :soon: JOB-APX-112 running.
MarketplaceBot: Note: next AtlasGate vetting window is 2026-05-10 UTC. plan manifest submit by 2026-04-24.
Samir: Thanks team. I'll draft announcement copy once perf numbers land and assets are in.
